title: SPECIAL PARKING REGULATIONS
previewText: In Subdistricts A, B, C, and D, the underlying parking and loading regulations shall be modified by the provisions of this Section. On waterfront blocks, the provisions of Section 62-40 shall not apply. In Subdistrict E, the underlying regulations shall apply.
